newsitem.title: GREECE: ECU/DRACHMA FIRMS, GREEK BONDS,DEPOS,FORWARDS IDLE.
newsitem.headline: ECU/DRACHMA FIRMS, GREEK BONDS,DEPOS,FORWARDS IDLE.

text.p: The ecu nudged higher against the drachma trading around 311.45/50, depos and forex forwards were paralysed and bonds were unmoved in late subdued trading with London and U.S. markets closed, traders said.

"Ecu/drachma is firmer trading around 311.45/50 in late lacklustre trade," said a forex dealer at a foreign bank. "It will be interesting to see what is going to happen tomorrow when London and New York markets open."
U.S markets were closed today in observance of Memorial Day.
The dealer said he expected ecu/drachma to open higher on Tuesday but capped at 312 on fears of central bank intervention at the fixing.
Prices of fixed coupon bonds, FRNs and zeros were unmoved in late dull trade, dealers said.

"We have had very few deals today and prices are unchanged," said a bond dealer at a private bank. "We might see some selling tomorrow if ecu/drachma rises but June's paper supply remains the market's major concern."
The treasury will issue 12-month T-bills at 9.60 percent on June 2, down 10 basis points, reopen bids for three-, five- and seven-year coupon bonds and auction 10-year fixed coupon bonds on June 19.
Greece auctioned three-year, 9.80 percent bonds, five-year, 9.20 percent bonds and seven-year, 8.9 percent bonds on March 19.
The finance ministry cut its three-, six- and 12-month T-bill rates by a tenth of a point to 8.50 percent, 8.80 percent and 9.60 percent respectively effective Monday, it said.
Interbank depos and forex forwards were steady in late thin trading.
"Depos and forex forwards are holding morning levels in thin trading volume," said a dealer at a private bank. "It has been very quiet today with some major foreign markets closed."
The mark was quoted at 159.90/00 from Monday's 159.870 fix, the dollar at 270.15/25 drachmas from 269.340 and the ecu at 311.64/74 from 311.370 drachmas.
